text: Coffee with Gemma and Andre. Gemma's got a second interview at the council on Thursday and is properly nervous about it. Andre's gone vegan since the summer, so no more bacon rolls at his. Text Gemma good luck the night before.

Long catch-up with Miriam. Her son Hugo turns 9 on Saturday and he's obsessed with Lego Technic, specifically the big cranes. She says anything space themed also goes down well. Need to order something by Wednesday so it arrives in time. Her daughter Elif is off to Paris with the school on Friday too, first time away from home, and Miriam is the one fretting about it.
Ivan applied for the senior analyst role at Moreau & Lewis. Hears back next Tuesday. Ask him how it went the day after.
Bridget can't do gluten, coeliac since her twenties. Fern only drinks oat flat whites. Worth remembering for Sunday.

Dinner at Siddharth and Neha's was lovely. Their anniversary is the week after next and they're going to the Lake District for it. Sid mentioned Neha's been eyeing up a proper pasta machine, could be a good shout for her birthday in March. He's also mid way through applying for a PhD at Leeds, deadline Friday.
Dafydd's interview got moved, now Monday at 10. He was gutted because he'd booked the whole of Friday off for it. I should ring him that morning.
Thabo hates mushrooms. Like, genuinely won't eat anything they've touched.
Afua's mum is in hospital again, hip this time. Afua's driving up to Leicester tomorrow and staying till the operation on Wednesday. Check in with her a couple of days afterwards.

Quick one: Marta's 30th is a week on Saturday. Drinks at the Crown. She's into bouldering and natural wine, a voucher for the climbing centre might be the move. Her flatmate Joy is organising, said she'll send details on Monday. Marta's also off dairy at the moment so maybe skip the cheese board idea.

Picked up Dev from the station. He's finally got an interview at the hospital trust, Wednesday afternoon. Says he hasn't done one in eight years and is bricking it. His partner Joy is doing a mock interview with him tomorrow night. Send him a message Wednesday morning.
Emily's sister Leah is pregnant, due in April! Emily's going to be an aunt for the first time and can't stop talking about it.
Bought the wine for Friday. Need to pick up the cake on Thursday after work and drop the car at the garage Saturday morning.
Ahmed's birthday was yesterday and I completely forgot. Need to get him something this weekend. He's been banging on about wanting a decent espresso grinder for months.
Rafael and Ifeoma are hosting a curry night next Saturday. Ifeoma's allergic to peanuts so whatever I bring has to be nut free. Rafael said bring beer, he likes anything dark, stouts and porters.

Wei didn't get the job at the bank. Found out on Monday. She's pretty flat about it but says she's going to apply to two more next week. Don't forget to check in with her at the weekend. Her brother Obi works in recruitment and has offered to look over her CV, which she's doing tomorrow.
Joseph's retirement do was supposed to be this Friday but it's been called off, his wife's poorly. Hope she's ok.
Elif's dog Biscuit had his teeth out on Tuesday, recovering fine apparently. Elif's started a new job at the vets in town so she gets mates' rates anyway.
Met Hugo Santos at the networking thing. Works in procurement, used to live in Lisbon, really into cycling. Said he'd forward my CV to his hiring manager.
Helen's son Sean has his driving test on Thursday. Third attempt. She's more nervous than he is.

Catch-up call with Eva tonight. She's left the agency and is going freelance from November. Her boyfriend Obi is moving down from Glasgow to join her the week after. They're doing a little housewarming once he's settled, probably mid November. She still doesn't drink, so get some of that alcohol free fizz in.
Neha said Siddharth's mum keeps a strict veggie kitchen, no eggs either.
Need to finish my cover letter for the Okafor job before Sunday. Interview prep the day after if they call.
Andile's having a rough time, been off work two weeks with burnout. Wife's handling the kids. Might take him for a pint next week, see how he's doing.
Alejandro's birthday is on the 14th. Big Real Madrid fan, wants the new away shirt. His wife Gemma says he's also into whisky, peaty stuff mainly.
Anders had his final interview at Suzuki on Monday. He thinks it went well. They said they'd let him know by the end of the week. Remind me to ask him on Friday.
Fern texted. Her dad's 70th is on Sunday and she's doing a surprise lunch for him. She's stressed about the seating plan. Offer to help the day before?
Miriam and her husband are off to Japan next Thursday for two weeks. Their cat Pickle needs feeding while they're away, I said I'd pop in every other day.

Lunch with Ivan and Bridget. Bridget's doing Dry October and is already counting the days. Ivan has started making sourdough and brought a loaf, very good. He wants a proofing basket for Christmas, hinted heavily.
Dev's grandad passed away at the weekend. Funeral's on the 3rd. I should send a card before then.
Gemma said her brother Thabo got into the fire service! Starts training in January. Send congrats.
Rang Afua back. Op went fine, her mum's home on Friday. Afua's knackered though, been sleeping on a camp bed at the hospital.
Marta asked if I'd be a referee for her application at the university. Need to email the form back by Tuesday.
Ifeoma is lactose intolerant but fine with goat's cheese, weirdly.

Notes from the Saturday walk: Sean has a job interview at the brewery on Wednesday. Helen said he's thinking of quitting uni if he gets it. Emily is training for the Cardiff half in March. Leah's scan is on the 2nd and she's nervous. Ask Emily how the scan went afterwards.

Big family call. Uncle Dafydd retires at the end of the month after 35 years at the post office. Auntie Joy is planning a party for him the Saturday after. Everyone's chipping in for a watch. Need to send my share to Joy by Friday.
Elif and Wei both coming for dinner on Saturday. Elif's pescatarian, Wei doesn't eat pork. Do the salmon.
Andre's leaving drinks are tomorrow, he's off to the Edinburgh office. Card's going round tonight, I should sign it.
Joseph's daughter Eva just had her baby, a little girl called Rosa. Born Tuesday morning. Joseph is over the moon.
Heard back from the recruiter, I've got a first interview on Monday at 2. Prepping all weekend.
Siddharth didn't hear back from Leeds yet. He's anxious, keeps refreshing his email. Text him next week to see if there's any news.
Obi loves hot sauce, collects the weird ones. Good shout for Secret Santa.

Catch up with Rafael, he's interviewing for a head chef job on Thursday and then a trial shift the following Monday. He's a bit nervous about the trial more than the interview. Ring him the night before the trial.
Hugo's birthday party is Sunday at the trampoline park, 2pm. His mum Miriam said he's into Pokemon cards now too. Grab a booster box this weekend.
Neha is off sugar for a month, doctor's orders. She's finding it hard.
Leah said Emily is applying for a teaching course, interview in a fortnight. Emily hasn't mentioned it to me yet.

Andile's back at work from Monday, phased return. Sounds a lot brighter. His wife Afua's birthday is next week, he's taking her to that tapas place. He says she's gone off meat completely so I warned him their chorizo is half the menu. Remember to send her a card.
Anders got the job!! Starts on 1 December. Celebratory drinks Thursday.
Bridget's mum is having a knee replacement next Tuesday. Bridget is staying with her the week after. Send flowers to her mum's house when she gets home.

Drinks with Thabo and Ahmed. Thabo is doing keto and was very smug about it. Ahmed says his wife Helen is expecting twins, due in May, and they're still in shock. He also has a big pitch at work on Friday that he's dreading. Message Ahmed good luck Friday morning and maybe something for the babies later on.
Gemma got the council job! Starts in three weeks. She wants to celebrate this weekend.
Dafydd's wife Bridget can't have shellfish. Remember for the barbecue.
Fern's dad's lunch got cancelled, he's come down with flu. She's rescheduling for the 9th.
Mrs Sato from next door told me her grandson Joseph is starting at Durham next autumn, he got his offer this morning.

Marta said her partner Dev is being made redundant at Christmas. He's applying everywhere but it's grim. They've had to cancel their trip to Portugal. Should check in on both of them in a couple of weeks.
Grocery run tomorrow. Also book the dentist and renew the car insurance before Friday.
Eva's into pottery now, takes a class on Tuesdays. Says she wants a little kiln eventually, dream gift.

Elif mentioned Ivan has an interview with the NHS trust on Friday. He's bringing his little girl to stay with his mum the day before so he can prep. Elif also said her own birthday is next Wednesday and she'd love a nice gin, something floral. Ask Ivan on Saturday how it went.
Alejandro "Ale" MacDonald from the five a side is diabetic, keep the drinks sugar free when he comes round.
Ifeoma had her interview this morning for the Moreau job. Said they asked loads of technical questions. Results next Thursday. I should follow up the day after.
Wei's boyfriend Sean proposed at the weekend! Engagement party in a fortnight, at his parents' place.
